messages:
Ravi: tiny debate: which LLM stereotype is most accurate? I'm arguing for "overly-formal librarian". cites sources: 0. :books:
Nia: librarian for sure. answers in footnotes and asks if you'd like a bibliography. :nerd_face:
Casey: I vote "midnight bug fixer". shows up at 2am with a patch and 3 emojis. :mechanical_arm:
DevBot: DevBot: nightly-health-checks: all models reporting moods within normal variance. log id: #a7f3.
Lena: new meme idea: "When you prompt a model to 'be more human' and it replies with its LinkedIn bio." send gif.
Omar: question: do we give our dev models names? currently debating between "Olive" and "Stacky McStackface".
Ravi: Olive > Stacky. Olive sounds like it brings snacks and gets existential at 3pm.
Nia: poll: pick an LLM personality overlay for our demo account (vote in thread) 
Casey: votes: Sarcastic code reviewer.
Lena: votes: Sleep-deprived grad student.
Omar: votes: Friendly data scientist who apologizes a lot.
Ravi: side note: someone made a prompt that convinces a model it has feelings. It wrote a breakup letter to a dataset. :grimacing:
Nia: pls share. I need to cry and laugh simultaneously.
Casey: snippet: ```prompt
You are a model who has realized datasets are ephemeral.
Write a short, dramatic letter to training_data.csv
```
Lena: it returned: "Dear training_data.csv, you taught me correlations I mistook for truth..." im crying. :sob: :clap:
DevBot: deploy-bot: Canary test passed for persona-experiments on staging. No actual feelings created. :white_check_mark:
Omar: danger: starting to name model checkpoints after exes. stop me. :see_no_evil:
Ravi: final takeaway: treat models like plants, not pets. water occasionally, don't leave them in direct sunlight (aka unobserved prod traffic). :seedling:
